# RisingWave

> > RisingWave is an event streaming platform providing SQL-based stream processing for real-time analytics, AI agents, and applications, with support for Apache Iceberg and Kafka integration.

RisingWave Labs, founded in 2021 by Yingjun Wu in San Francisco, offers both open-source and cloud-hosted solutions for event streaming and real-time data processing. The platform enables streaming lakehouses, monitoring, IoT applications, and analytics workflows.

## Key Topics

- RisingWave
- Event streaming
- Stream processing
- Apache Iceberg
- Kafka
- Real-time analytics
- SQL stream processing
- RisingWave Cloud
- Streaming lakehouse
- AI agents
- IoT applications
- Monitoring and observability
- PostgreSQL compatibility
